plugins.name: browser
plugins.label: Browser (headless Chrome)
plugins.description: Headless Chrome as the universal adapter for web applications without a plugin of their own: navigate, read, screenshot, click, type.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.label: Dev sandbox
plugins.description: The agent's own computer: shell commands, long-running processes, and programming work handed to a sub-agent inside the project checkout.

plugins.name: email
plugins.label: Email (IMAP/SMTP)
plugins.description: A mail account of its own: sift the inbox over IMAP, read attachments, reply and send over SMTP.

plugins.name: gitea
plugins.label: Gitea / Forgejo
plugins.description: Self-hosted git forge: find issues and pull requests, read them, comment, label and close.

versions.notes: First release. Written from the published API docs, not yet exercised against a live system.

plugins.name: github
plugins.label: GitHub
plugins.description: Issues and pull requests as the working set: check out, fix, open a pull request, diagnose red Actions runs, review others' work.

plugins.name: gitlab
plugins.label: GitLab
plugins.description: Issues as the working set: check out the code, fix, commit onto a branch, open a merge request and live the review loop.

plugins.name: k8s
plugins.label: Kubernetes
plugins.description: Read a cluster: pod states and restarts, container logs including the crashed one, events, workloads, Ingresses, RBAC and NetworkPolicies. Secrets stay unreadable.

versions.notes: Was compiled into Covey up to 0.5.0, and never listed in the catalogue. The cluster CA is no longer an action parameter: store it as the secret k8s_ca and the host builds the trust store from it.

plugins.name: nextcloud
plugins.label: Nextcloud files
plugins.description: A Nextcloud file store over WebDAV, through a share link or an account: list, read, write and delete files.

plugins.name: openproject
plugins.label: OpenProject
plugins.description: Project management: find work packages, read them, comment and move them through their status.

versions.notes: First release. Written from the published API docs, not yet exercised against a live system.

plugins.name: redmine
plugins.label: Redmine
plugins.description: Issue tracker: find issues, read them, comment, change status and assignee.

versions.notes: First release. Written from the published API docs, not yet exercised against a live system.

plugins.name: sharepoint
plugins.label: SharePoint / Teams files
plugins.description: A SharePoint document library through a share link: list, read, write and delete files.

plugins.name: teams
plugins.label: Microsoft Teams
plugins.description: A chat channel through the Azure Bot Service: receive messages at a JWT-verified endpoint, answer through the Bot Connector.

plugins.name: vulndb
plugins.label: Vulnerability databases
plugins.description: Known vulnerabilities in declared dependencies: scan a lock file against OSV.dev, fetch advisories, look up the next safe version. Needs no credentials.

versions.notes: Was compiled into Covey up to 0.5.0. NVD now answers at its anonymous rate limit: vulndb_token no longer has an effect, because a module is never handed a credential for a host it only declared.

plugins.name: zammad
plugins.label: Zammad
plugins.description: Open-source helpdesk: read tickets with their conversation, reply internally or to the customer, set state, escalate. Woken by trigger webhooks.

versions.notes: Was compiled into Covey up to 0.5.0. Same actions; COVEY_ZAMMAD_REPLY_TYPE is now the reply_type parameter, and the group allowlist belongs in the Zammad trigger.
